title: Claude limit bachane ka slash advisor
content:
Claude ki limit hit na ho.
Sabse aasaan tareeka Claude Code ke andar hai.
Naam hai advisor.

Ek sasta model saara kaam karta hai.
Files ka naam badalna.
Docs padhna.
Tests chalana.
Opus tab aata hai, jab mushkil faisla ho.
Jaise database kaise kaam kare.
Ya koi zaroori email bhejni hai ya nahi.

Opus manager ban kar kaam karta hai, intern ki tarah nahi.
Zaroori hisson pe Opus se jawab milta hai.
Limit bahut der tak chalti hai, kyunki baaki models saste padte hain.

Claude Code kholo.
Slash advisor type karo.
Opus choose karo.
